title: Name the WMBT object of control as a kebab-case noun phrase

facts.note: Task or plan text mentions authoring/editing a WMBT or its object of control.

values: WMBT object_of_control field added or modified
facts.note: Requires a diff-level observer over planner artifacts that detects a new/changed WMBT and its object_of_control value.
Kebab-case form is mechanically checkable; whether it is a noun phrase naming the specific controlled subject needs LLM judgement.

fires: Planner authors a new WMBT and must state what it controls or manipulates.
Planner edits an existing WMBT's object of control.
doesNotFire: Planner edits only a WMBT's acceptance wording without touching its object of control.
Work on code or tests that does not create or change a WMBT.

given: A planner is authoring or revising a WMBT
when: the WMBT's object of control (the controlled subject of the WMBT) is set or changed
then: Synthesize the specific thing being controlled or manipulated as a kebab-case noun phrase.
prefer: A specific noun phrase in kebab-case naming the controlled subject, e.g. `user-profile`, `payment-flow`.
avoid: Verbs, actions or full sentences as the object of control instead of a noun phrase.
why: A WMBT is scoped to one object of control, and the WMBT statement template consumes it, so it must be a specific, consistently formatted noun phrase.
evidence: Each WMBT's object_of_control value matches a kebab-case pattern and reads as a noun phrase naming a specific controlled subject.
verifier_detail: Pattern: kebab-case noun phrase (lowercase words joined by single hyphens). Positive examples: `user-profile`, `payment-flow`.
Term id: object_of_control — defined as 'the controlled subject of the WMBT.'
